facts.fact: The document states that on 29 September 2020 China Eximbank and Burkina Faso's Ministry of Security signed an RMB 560 million loan to finance a commercial contract with Huawei and CITCC for a 650 km fibre optic backbone linking cities and localities, plus a 150 km fibre network.
The document states the project officially commenced on 8 July 2021, with completion expected within 54 months (8 January 2026).
